prompt: At a bustling night market, a vendor with a large mustache stirs a wok of noodles on a cart in the center, steam rising in stylized swirls. A customer in a purple hoodie stands to the left, holding chopsticks and looking eagerly at the food. On the right, a stray cat with fluffy white fur sits on a crate, watching a fish hang from a hook above. In the foreground, a lantern with glowing orange light hangs from a string, illuminating the scene with warm hues. A stack of bamboo steamers sits on the counter next to the wok, lids slightly ajar. Behind the vendor, strings of colorful flags flutter in the breeze against a dark blue sky. Another stall in the background displays piles of bright red apples and green vegetables. The characters have exaggerated features and smooth, shiny textures typical of modern animation. Reflections on the wet pavement suggest recent rain, adding depth to the composition. The lighting creates a cozy, inviting atmosphere amidst the urban chaos. Every element is carefully positioned to guide the eye through the narrative of the meal. This is a 3D animated film still.
